units.text: The May 2022 IETF Internet-Draft references RFC 7231, which classifies PUT as idempotent, consistent with a June 2022 timeframe.

judgement.reason: The passage supports that the draft references RFC 7231 and classifies PUT as idempotent, but it does not mention a May 2022 Internet-Draft date or a June 2022 timeframe.

units.text: RFC 9110 Section 9.2.2 and its method property table explicitly list PUT among the idempotent methods GET, HEAD, OPTIONS, TRACE, PUT, and DELETE.

citations.title: RFC 9110 Explained: Safe & Idempotent HTTP Methods
RFC 9110 Explained: Safe & Idempotent HTTP Methods

judgement.reason: The passages state Section 9.2.2 makes PUT idempotent, identify the full idempotent set as GET, HEAD, OPTIONS, TRACE, PUT, and DELETE, and include a method table row marking PUT as idempotent.

units.text: RFC 9110 was published in June 2022 as Internet Standard STD 97, establishing the worldwide HTTP standard scope.

citations.title: RFC 9110 Explained: Safe & Idempotent HTTP Methods

judgement.reason: The passage supports publication in June 2022 as Internet Standard STD 97, but does not mention establishing the worldwide HTTP standard scope.
